Implemented the simulator as a standard Cargo project under `output/`, with the CLI and file layout you specified. The binary accepts `--input` and `--output`, supports the optional tool/parameter/probe/trace flags, writes JSON output on both success and error, writes trace JSON when requested, and keeps `[dependencies]` empty in [Cargo.toml](/workspace/output/Cargo.toml).

Builds were verified with `cargo build --release --manifest-path output/Cargo.toml`. I also exercised representative cases for live `#` parameter evaluation, state-only lines, `G43` tool-length offsets, canned-cycle trace timing, and `G38.2` probe hit/non-hit behavior. The least battle-tested area is cutter-radius compensation geometry, but the simulator is in place and runnable at `cargo run --release --manifest-path output/Cargo.toml -- <arguments>`.
